Overlays

Purpose: content above content — each with a native foundation, a

Purpose: content above content — each with a native foundation, a documented dismissal contract, and no focus traps.

Dialog

Native <dialog>, dressed. Modal is the default (showModal() gives Escape, backdrop, and focus containment free).

<dialog class="sq-dialog" id="confirm-delete" aria-labelledby="confirm-title">
  <button
    class="sq-button sq-button--secondary sq-button--icon-only sq-dialog__close"
    type="button"
    data-sq-dialog-close
    aria-label="Close dialog"
  >
    …
  </button>
  <div class="sq-stack">
    <h2 class="sq-heading--3" id="confirm-title">Delete project?</h2>
    <p class="sq-text">
      This removes the project and its history. This cannot be undone.
    </p>
    <div class="sq-cluster">
      <button class="sq-button sq-button--danger" type="button">
        Delete project
      </button>
      <button
        class="sq-button sq-button--tertiary"
        type="button"
        data-sq-dialog-close
      >
        Keep it
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</dialog>
<button
  class="sq-button sq-button--primary"
  type="button"
  data-sq-dialog-open="confirm-delete"
>
  Delete…
</button>
<script>
  Squircle.initDialogs(); // once; idempotent
  // Or explicitly:
  Squircle.openDialog(document.getElementById("confirm-delete"));
  Squircle.closeDialog(document.getElementById("confirm-delete")); // restores invoker focus
  Squircle.closeDialog(document.getElementById("confirm-delete"), false); // closes without restoring focus
</script>

Sizes: default 36rem, --large 48rem. Panel sections compose inside.

Backdrop policy: backdrop clicks close ONLY dialogs carrying data-sq-dismiss="backdrop". Dialogs often guard unsaved work; silent dismissal would lose it. Escape always works (platform).

Modal vs non-modal: openDialog(el) is modal; { modal: false } uses show() (page stays interactive, no backdrop) with the same focus placement and restoration. Platform note: Escape closes modal dialogs natively but NOT modeless ones — every modeless dialog needs its visible close control (tested behavior, not an omission).

Focus: opens on [autofocus], else the first focusable control, else the dialog itself (never lost to <body>). Closes restore the invoker without scrolling the page (an overlay closing must not jump the viewport). closeDialog(el, false) skips restoration — honored both for API calls and the declarative wiring's own close listener. No traps: Tab cycles natively in modal dialogs; non-modal dialogs never capture Tab.

Menu (actions, not navigation)

<button
  class="sq-button sq-button--secondary"
  type="button"
  data-sq-menu
  aria-controls="export-menu"
>
  Export
</button>
<ul
  class="sq-menu"
  id="export-menu"
  role="menu"
  aria-label="Export options"
  hidden
>
  <li role="none">
    <button class="sq-menu__item" role="menuitem" type="button">
      PDF document
    </button>
  </li>
  <li role="none">
    <button class="sq-menu__item" role="menuitem" type="button">
      CSV data <span class="sq-menu__hint">⌘E</span>
    </button>
  </li>
  <li><hr class="sq-menu__separator" /></li>
  <li role="none">
    <button
      class="sq-menu__item sq-menu__item--danger"
      role="menuitem"
      type="button"
    >
      Delete export
    </button>
  </li>
</ul>
<script>
  Squircle.initMenus();
</script>

data-sq-menu + aria-controls binds trigger to menu (also via createMenu(trigger, menu)). Opens on click/ArrowDown/Enter/Space — ArrowUp opens with the LAST item focused (APG dropdown pattern); ArrowDown/Up/Home/End move within the open menu; Enter/Space activate natively (authors' handlers run unmodified); Escape closes and restores; Tab closes WITHOUT restoring (focus travels naturally — never trapped); click-outside closes. Disabled items use aria-disabled="true" (skipped by arrows, not activated).

Positioning: .sq-menu overlays — positioned absolute at the --sq-z-index-dropdown tier, so opening never pushes content down. The menu anchors to its nearest positioned ancestor: author it beside its trigger inside a positioned container (a relative wrapper or the nav/section it belongs to). Coarse placement stays author-owned by design; the runtime keeps it stacked and out of flow.

sq-menu__item--danger pairs the error color with an explicit verb — never color alone. sq-menu__hint shows shortcut text (informational, also documented in prose where it matters).

Limitations: no type-ahead; submenus are out of scope (flatten the actions instead); role="menu" expects menuitem children — authors own the roles, the runtime owns the behavior.

Popover (supplementary content)

<button
  class="sq-button sq-button--tertiary"
  type="button"
  id="quota-info"
  popovertarget="quota-pop"
>
  How is quota counted?
</button>
<div
  class="sq-popover"
  id="quota-pop"
  popover="auto"
  data-sq-popover-anchor="quota-info"
  aria-labelledby="quota-title"
>
  <h2 class="sq-popover__title" id="quota-title">
    Quota counts seats, not invites
  </h2>
  <p class="sq-text sq-muted">Pending invitations never consume a seat.</p>
</div>
<script>
  Squircle.initPopovers();
</script>

Show/hide/light-dismiss stay native. Without the anchor attribute the popover centers (platform default — complete alone). With it, positionPopover places it beside the trigger and works out the placement in a resolved order — requested first, then its opposite, then the perpendicular pair — so it flips any direction when space runs out, clamping inside the viewport as the last resort (data-sq-popover-placement="top|bottom|left|right" picks the requested side; unknown values warn and fall back to "bottom"). While a popover stays open, scrolling or resizing the page repositions it, so it never visually detaches from its trigger. No animation (instant both ways — reduced-motion safe by construction).

Tooltip (hints, never essentials)

<button
  class="sq-button sq-button--secondary"
  type="button"
  data-sq-tooltip="Exports include archived projects."
>
  Export
</button>
<script>
  Squircle.initTooltips();
</script>

Plain-text content, one shared live element, shown on hover AND focus, hidden on leave/blur/Escape/scroll. aria-describedby wiring is transient — the tooltip's id is added while shown and removed when hidden, preserving any author-provided descriptions. The page must make full sense with tooltips disabled — if the information is essential, print it inline.

Accessibility notes (all four)

  • Semantics are author-owned and native (dialog, popover,

menu/menuitem, role="tooltip"); the runtime manages behavior only.

  • Contrast verified under Luca and Ocean, including disabled items and

tooltip text.

  • Touch: everything opens by tap; nothing essential is hover-only;

targets honor the 48px policy (menu items 44px in dense rows — the documented exception, still above the 44px floor).

  • Reduced motion: dialogs/popovers/tooltips appear instantly; the

switch-like transitions that remain are gated.

Theme behavior

Surfaces, borders, scrims, and text are tokens. The scrim darkens both themes without hiding page context entirely.

Common mistakes

  • Backdrop-dismissed confirmations (data-sq-dismiss on a delete

dialog) — data loss by misclick.

  • Menus for site navigation — links, always.
  • Tooltips carrying the only copy of an error or price.
  • role="menu" on a list of links — that is navigation, not a menu.

Tested limitations

  • Menu type-ahead unsupported; submenus unsupported.
  • Popover anchor positioning measures on open — hidden-then-shown

popovers position correctly; never-positioned ones center natively.

  • Dialog autofocus inside non-modal dialogs scrolls the page to the

dialog on open (platform behavior).
